description: Create a contact in Dynamics 365 Sales. Required: last_name. Optional: first_name, email, phone, mobile, job_title, description, account_id (the company), fields. Checks for an existing contact with the same e-mail first. WRITES into the customer's Dynamics 365 — it goes through the permission gate and the Dynamics write log (audit_log dynamics_write).

allow_duplicate.description: set only after a human confirmed that the found duplicate is a different record

fields.description: further Dataverse columns by logical name (lower case, e.g. {"address1_city":"Leipzig"}); lookups as {"parentaccountid@odata.bind":"/accounts(<GUID>)"}

name: create_dynamics_contact
